summary: Frontend-only verification of UserStreamingApp.jsx changes for Gracefy: footer legal links to gracefy.net, mini-player bottom positioning on mobile vs desktop, and three-dots context menus on MiniPlayer & FullPlayer. All 7 requested features verified on live preview URL.

design_issues.screen: Mobile viewport (width<1024px) mini-player + bottom nav stack
issues: Mini-player is pinned at bottom-14 (56px) while mobile nav's computed height is 62px (py-2 + 20px icon + 10px label). This creates a ~6px vertical overlap where the top 6px of the nav bar sits underneath the mini-player's border. Visually it is barely noticeable (the progress line stays visible) but strictly speaking the mini-player should be at bottom-16 (64px) or the nav should be explicitly 56px tall to match bottom-14. Recommend changing mini-player to 'bottom-16 lg:bottom-0' OR adjusting mobile nav to a fixed 56px height.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Align mobile nav height with mini-player's bottom-14 offset to avoid 6px overlap. Options: (a) change MiniPlayer to 'bottom-16 lg:bottom-0' in UserStreamingApp.jsx line ~2580, or (b) reduce mobile nav py-2 to py-1 / set explicit h-14 so its height becomes exactly 56px.
critical_code_review_comments: UserStreamingApp.jsx is 6903 lines - exceeds the 700-line threshold. Strongly recommend splitting MiniPlayer, FullPlayer, ProfileView, LegalPage, and AlbumView into separate files under /app/frontend/src/components/streaming/ for maintainability.
Duplicate onShare logic (navigator.share / clipboard fallback) is repeated identically for MiniPlayer and FullPlayer (lines ~6700-6711 and ~6731-6743). Extract into a single shareSong(song) helper.
Duplicate onDownload / onAddToPlaylist handlers both simply call setShowDownloadPopup(true) in both MiniPlayer and FullPlayer - same extract-to-helper suggestion.

Good: data-testid attributes are properly added on all new interactive elements (footer-terms-link, footer-privacy-link, footer-contact-link, mini-player-more-menu, mini-player-menu-like/share/add-playlist, full-player-more-menu, full-player-menu-*, full-player-share-btn).
test_credentials: Not used - all changes tested as unauthenticated user on live preview URL. test_credentials.md is missing but was not required for this UI-only verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Footer legal links (sidebar + Settings page) verified as <a target='_blank'> with exact gracefy.net URLs. Desktop MiniPlayer computed bottom=0px on lg viewport. Mobile MiniPlayer computed bottom=56px, mobile nav computed bottom=0px & height=62px (6px overlap - minor). Three-dots menus open and render Like/Share/Add to Playlist items on both MiniPlayer (data-testid mini-player-menu-*) and FullPlayer (full-player-menu-*). FullPlayer bottom-actions Share button (data-testid full-player-share-btn) is wired to onShare. App content loads from BunnyCDN - allow 7-10s after initial load before interacting. To trigger player: click any [data-testid^='album-alb_'] then [data-testid='play-album-btn']. On mobile viewport full-player auto-opens; click the back/ChevronLeft button to collapse to mini-player.
rca of the issue: N/A - no blocking bugs found. The 6px mini-player/nav overlap is a layout spec mismatch (bottom-14=56px vs nav intrinsic height 62px). Fix: use bottom-16 (64px) or set explicit h-14 on the mobile nav.
